description: Check the whole JSON that POST https://api.iomarkets.tech/v1/proof/execution returned ({ audit, summary, attestation }): that the ed25519 signature matches the published IoMarkets key, that its USDC payment is confirmed on Algorand mainnet (a public indexer IoMarkets does not run), that the rows hash to the signed audit_sha256, and that every row and the summary recompute with the API's own scoring, against the last trade and against the arrival mid (side-aware cost, qty-weighted averages, spread, matched and unmatched fills). The same checks as the page at https://iomarkets.tech/execution-check. Returns each check, and the recomputed summary as structured data.

report.description: The response body as JSON text, exactly as received: { "audit": [...], "summary": {...}, "attestation": { "payload": {...}, "signature": "…" } }.

name: verify_execution_report
title: Check an execution-quality report
